sentences.ar: أَبحَرَ زيدٌ السفينةَ ليلًا هُدُوْءً له

parts.label: a
parts.ask: Identify the type of maf'ool present for each underlined word/phrase by ticking the correlating box.

parts.label: b
parts.feedback:
Hudu'an can be mafool lahu, he sailed in order to be calm.
Like: He hit zaid in order to teach manners
or
Hudu'an is Naib anil mafool mutlaq, ie he sailed a relaxing, calmful, tranquil sailing.

parts.label: c
parts.ask: Write your translation whilst ensuring all the Mafools are clear in your translation.
parts.my_response: zaid sailed the ship at night as it was calm for him

flags: Diacritics on 'أبحرَ زيدٌ السفينةَ ليلًا هدوءً له' transcribed to the best legibility from the image; the final 'له' is rendered لَهُ though the printed image shows no visible haraka on it.

Row 'السفينة' and 'ليلا' confirmed correct by green check; row 'هدوء' was ticked مفعول له (0/1) and the 'Correct answers' key shows BOTH مفعول مطلق and مفعول له ticked, explained by the teacher feedback under part b as either mafool lahu or naib 'anil mafool mutlaq.

Vowels on أَبحَرَ (hamza's fatha is clearly drawn; the fatha on ح is agreed by both readers; whether the remaining stroke sits over ر or over ب could not be pinned down with full certainty at this resolution) could not be read with certainty.
